Workshop commands · Agent orchestration with Claude
===================================================

To paste into the Teams chat, one at a time, at the right step of the presentation.
Each command stands alone, between blank lines: copy only the command line.
Lines that start with # are for you (the slide, the agenda time, what it is).
# Generated by slides/build-v2.mjs from slides/content-v2.en.mjs: do not edit by hand.

########################################################################
# Before you start · if you already installed, run the setup again (it updates the kit, adds the short commands and registers you on the panel; then close and reopen the terminal)
########################################################################

# Mac (Terminal)
curl -fsSL https://github.com/cx-guilherme-pinto/workshop-claude/releases/download/v1.1.0-rc.4/setup-mac.sh | bash

# Windows (PowerShell)
irm https://github.com/cx-guilherme-pinto/workshop-claude/releases/download/v1.1.0-rc.4/bootstrap-windows.ps1 | iex

########################################################################

# In a terminal
agent-memory-gui

########################################################################
# [5:00] slide 6 · Check and join the panel
########################################################################

# 1 · Join the panel (Mac and Windows)
workshop-register

# If the command does not exist (setup older than rc.4), paste this one:
node "$HOME/.workshop-claude/kit/telemetry/ctl.mjs" register

# 2 · Check the kit (Mac and Windows)
workshop-check

# If the command does not exist (setup older than rc.4), paste this one:
# Mac
bash ~/.workshop-claude/setup-mac.sh --check

# Windows (PowerShell)
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$env:USERPROFILE\.workshop-claude\setup-windows.ps1" -Check
